name: Patrick Hughes
source:
Profession: Violinist
Favorite Place: Couch in His Room

He knows what he likes so well that not everyone finds him easy to get along with.
Though he doesn't speak much, he is an incredibly caring individual.
I wish he were more honest and knew when to be polite.
